mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.25%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE (measured by the product of their z-scores) has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a monthly growth rate in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, RSAFS growth above 0.5% is associated with positive 20-day SPX returns in less than 45% of months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth rate has a Rank IC < 0.05 with 5-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals weak residential construction and declining consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1000.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of months when UNRATE declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong supply-side economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 (measured by the product of their z-scores) has a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
